spans.s:
mfn. (-र्घः-र्घा-र्घं)
Long, applied either to space or time.
m. (-र्धः)
1 The Śāl tree.
2 A long vowel.
3 The 5th, 6th, 7th, or 8th sign of the zodiac.
E.
दॄ to divide or send, affix घञ्.

m. (-कः)
A sort of crane, the Vaka, (Ardea nivea.)
E.
दीर्घ long, कण्ठ throat, and कन् added.

m. (-रः)
A sort of crane, (Ardea nivea.)
E.
दीर्घ, and कन्धर neck.

n. (-लं)
A long time, a long period.
E.
दीर्घ, and काल time.

n. (-ष्ठं)
A spar, a beam, a long piece of timber.
E.
दीर्घ, and काष्ठ wood.

m. (-लः)
A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.)
E.
दीर्घ long, कील a stem or stake; also with कन्, दीर्घकीलक.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
Long-haired.
m. (-शः)
A bear.
E.
दीर्घ, and केश hair.

f. (का)
A cockle; also दीर्घ, कोशी, &c. see the next.

f. (-का)
A cockle.
E.
दीर्घ long, कोश or कोष a sheath or shell, affix ङीप्, दीर्घकोषी, or दीर्घकोशी and कन् with the fem. form added, दीर्घकोशिका, -षिका.

m. (-तिः)
A camel.
E.
दीर्घ, and गति going.

m. (-वः)
1 A camel.
2 A kind of curlew.
E.
दीर्घ long, and ग्रीवा a neck.

m. (-कः)
A camel.
E.
दीर्घ long, घाटा the neck, affix ठन्.

m. (-लः)
A kind of fish, commonly Bhangan.
E.
दीर्घ long, and जङ्गल desert.

mfn. (-ङ्घः-ङ्घा-ङ्घं)
Long-thighed.
m. (-ङ्घः)
1 A crane.
2 A camel.
E.
दीर्घ long, and जङ्घा a thigh.

m. (-ह्वः)
A snake.
E.
दीर्घ long, and जिह्वा a tongue.

m. (-वः)
Long life.
E.
दीर्घ, and जीव life; also दीर्घजीवित.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Living or existing a long time.
E.
दीर्घ, and जीविन् who lives.

mfn. (-नुः-नुः-नु)
Tall, long.
E.
दीर्घ, and तनु body.

m. (-रुः)
The Tāla or palm tree.
E.
दीर्घ long, and तरु a tree.

f. (-षा)
A kind of cucumber: see कर्क्कटी.

f. (-ण्डा)
The musk shrew.
E.
दीर्घ, and तुण्डा a snout.

m. (-ण्डः)
The castor oil tree.
E.
दीर्घ long, दण्ड a stick or stem; also with कन् added, दीर्घदण्डकः

mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिणी-र्शि)
Far-seeing, provident, wise.
m. (-र्शी)
1 A wise or learned man, a seer, a prophet.
2 A vulture.
3 A bean.
E.
दीर्घ long, दृश to see, affix णिनि.

m. (-ष्टिः)
A wise or provident man; also,
mfn.
Wise, provident, far-seeing.
E.
दीर्घ long, and दृष्टि sight.

m. (-द्रुः)
The palm tree.
E.
दीर्घ long, and द्रु a tree.

m. (-दः)
A conch shell.
E.
दीर्घ, and नाद sound.

f. (-द्रा)
Death.
E.
दीर्घ long, and निद्रा sleep.

ind.
Sighing or having sighed deeply.
E.
दीर्घ, and निश्वस्य having sighed.

m. (-सः)
A long or deep drawn sigh.
E.
दीर्घ, and निश्वास a sigh.

m. (-क्षः)
The fork-tailed shrike.
E.
दीर्घ, and पक्ष a wing.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्री-त्रं)
Long-leaved longifolium.
m. (-त्रः)
Garlic.
f. (-त्रा)
1 A sort of

Eugenia.
2

A kind of Chakuliya.
E.
दीर्घ long, and पत्र a leaf.

m. (-कः)
1 A thorny plant: see करीर.
2 A kind of Bassia growing in marshy places.
3 Garlic.
E.
दीर्घ long, पत्र a leaf, and कन् added.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णी-र्णं)
Long-leaved longifolium.
E.
दीर्घ, and पर्ण a leaf.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वी-वं)
Having long shoots or tendrils.
m. (-वः)
The Śaṇa plant, (Crotolaria juneca.)
E.
दीर्घ, and पल्लव a shoot.

m. (-पः)
1 The cocoanut tree.
2 The betelnut tree.
E.
दीर्घ, and पादप a tree.

m. (-द् or त्)
A heron.
E.
दीर्घ long, and पाद for पद a foot; also with a final vowel दीर्घपाद m. (-दः)

m. (-ष्ठः)
A snake.
E.
दीर्घ long, and पृष्ठ back.

n. (-लं)
A plant, (Cassia fistula.)
E.
दीर्घ long, and फल fruit.

m. (-तः)
An elephant.
E.
दीर्घ long, मारुत wind er breath.

mfn. (-खः-खी-खं)
Long-faced.
E.
दीर्घ, and मुख the face.

mfn. (-लः-ला-ली-लं)
Having a long root.
m. (-लः)
A kind of Bilva tree.
n. (-लं)
A sort of sensitive plant.
f. (-ला)
1 A creeper, (Echites frutescens): see श्यामलता.
2 A plant, (Hedysarum gangeticum); also Śālaparṇī.
f. (-ली)
A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.)
E.
दीर्घ long, मूल a root.

m. (-तः)
A hog.
E.
दीर्घ long, and रत copulation.

m. (-दः)
A hog.
E.
दीर्घ long, and रद a tooth.

m. (-नः)
A snake.
E.
दीर्घ long, and रसना a tongue.

n. (-त्रं)
1 A long period.
2 A long night.
E.
दीर्घ long, and रात्र for रात्रि night.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Making a long continued noise, yelling, howling.
E.
दीर्घ, and राव cry.

mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि)
Being long ill.
E.
दीर्घ, and रोगिन् sick.

m. (-मा)
A bear.
E.
दीर्घ long, रोमन् hair of the body.

n. (-कं)
A fragrant sort of grass.
E.
दीर्घ, and रोहिषक another sort.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
1 Having a long staff or stick.
2 Being of an ancient family.
m. (-शः)
A reed.
E.
दीर्घ, and वंश a race, a bambu.

m. (-क्त्रः)
An elephant.
E.
दीर्घ long, and वक्त्र face.

f. (-का)
An alligator.

m. (-र्णः)
A long vowel.
E.
दीर्घ, and वर्ण a letter.

m. (-र्त्मा)
A long road, a long journey.
E.
दीर्घ, and वर्त्मन् a path.

m. (-न्तः)
A plant, (Bignonia Indica.)
E.
दीर्घ long, and वृन्त stalk; with कन् added दीर्घवृन्तक.

f. (-का)
A plant, (Mimosa octandra.)
E.
दीर्घ long, and वृन्त a stalk, कन् affix, with the fem. form.

m. (-खः)
The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.)
E.
दीर्घ long, and शाखा a branch.

mfn. (-क्थः-क्था-क्थं)
Long-thighed.
E.
दीर्घ long, and सक्थि a thigh, affix अच्; figuratively used, the compound retains its proper final, as दीर्घसक्थि चक्रं a long-spoked wheel.

n. (-त्रं)
1 A sort of religious ceremony, one of long continuance.
2 A place of pilgrimage.
E.
दीर्घ long, सत्र sacrifice, &c.

n. (-त्वं)
Long-continued observance of the chief daily rites.
E.
दीर्घ, and सन्ध्या the morning, noon, and evening oblation, त्व aff.

m. (-तः)
A dog.
E.
दीर्घ long, and सुरत coition.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं)
Dilatory, slow, tedious.
E.
दीर्घ long, and सूत्र line or thread.

f. (-ता)
Dilatoriness, tediousness.
E.
दीर्घसूत्र, and तल् added; also with त्व, दीर्घसूत्रत्व.

mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि)
Dilatory.
E.
दीर्घ, and सूत्रिन् having a line or thread.

m. (-रः)
1 A long vowel.
2 A long note, a minim or semibreve.
E.
दीर्घ, and स्वर a sound.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
A letter carrier, a messenger, an express.
m. (-गः)
A camel.
E.
दीर्घ long, अध्वन् a road, and ग who goes.

n. (-ध्व)
A long journey.
E.
दीर्घ, and अध्वन् a road.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Long ill.
E.
दीर्घ, and आमय sickness.

m. (-धः)
1 A spear, a javelin.
2 A hog.
E.
दीर्घ long, and आयुध weapon, or one so armed.

mfn. (-युः-युः-यु)
Long-lived.
m. (-युः)
1 The saint MĀRKAṆḌ

EYA.
2

The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.)
3 A crow.
4 A tree: see जीवक.
n. (-यु)
Long life.
E.
दीर्घ long, and आयुस् life.

mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं)
Long-lived.
E.
दीर्घ, and आयुष्य lived.

f. (-का)
A large and long pond.
E.
दीर्घ long, affix कन्, fem. form.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Torn, rent, sundered.
2 Frightened, afraid.
E.
दॄ to tear, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
